description: Read a bounded page of the canonical Taminyaran case conversation represented by an existing AI Web Chat thread capability. Returns public-safe message/attachment references, text, author role, channel and timestamps. Does not mark customer messages as read and performs no write. thread_token is POST-body-only and must never be placed in a URL.

before.description: Optional ISO-8601 exclusive upper-bound timestamp for older-page pagination.

name: conversation_read
